Name: (CP) Seasonal Fences
Author: kallawarcat
Description:
[font=Verdana][color=#dd7e6b][size=4]do you have seasonal mods for various things around your farm but find something is missing?

[/size][/color][/font]Presenting: Seasonal Fences!

This is my first attempt at a mod, because I could not find any seasonal mods for fences that were up to date!

Uses Content Patcher to update your fences. There are variants for all four seasons (spring, summer, fall, and winter), and all four fence types (wood, hardwood, stone, and iron). 

[color=#f9cb9c][size=4]to install:[/size][/color]

1. Make sure you have SMAPI and Content Patcher installed.
2. Place the "[CP] SeasonalFences" folder in your mods folder. 

To uninstall, simply delete the folder. 

[color=#b4a7d6][size=4]thank you for downloading![/size][/color]
